title: VaxBook rule set snapshot and engine contract
description: Go structs in ruleset/ and engine/ are the source (SAD §3). This schema checks shape. null is never valid; an optional member is omitted; members added after S1 are optional. Content checks live in ruleset.Validate and engine.Validate. They include the keywords the Go decoders do not enforce (enums, minLength, minItems, uniqueItems, the Id pattern). The Input schema accepts every Input that Evaluate assesses, so ⚪ INVALID_DATE (A9) stays reachable for a client that validates against it. Documents are I-JSON texts (RFC 7493): unique member names and well-formed Unicode (no unpaired surrogate escapes, no invalid UTF-8). A schema cannot express this, so the Go decoders reject such a text as a decode error. The root is a rule set snapshot; $defs Input and Output are the engine's input and output (engine slice S4a subset).

Span.description: An age, interval, offset or buffer as an ISO 8601 duration with one designator: P<n>D days, P<n>W weeks (7 days), P<n>M months (day of month clamped to the month end), P<n>Y years (12 months); n in 0..999, no leading zeros, upper case. Compound durations are not accepted yet.

Date.description: A civil date YYYY-MM-DD from 0001-01-01 to 9999-12-31 that exists in the proleptic Gregorian calendar. The pattern alone checks this, leap years included, so a validator that treats format as an annotation (the draft 2020-12 default) accepts exactly what the engine decodes.

illustrative.description: A fixture or demo rule set, not medically verified; the publish path never sets it.

products.description: The vaccine product catalog; added in engine slice S3a.

Product.description: A vaccine product of the catalog (SAD §5.2); added in engine slice S3a. ruleset.Validate checks that each disease exists.

live.description: The live-vaccine flag; required, so that an absent flag never reads as non-live.

retired.description: No longer given (F11.3); the product stays in the catalog with its series.

product.description: The product the series belongs to, which must list the series' disease; absent for a generic series. Added in engine slice S3a.

startAge.description: The start-age bracket of the series: the ages at dose 1 it applies to; required in a product group of more than one series (ruleset.Validate, EQ26). Added in engine slice S3b.

maxAgeStart.description: The exclusive maximum age at dose 1: dose 1 must be given before birth + maxAgeStart, so its last allowed day is birth + maxAgeStart - 1 day. Series-level, not per plan. Added in engine slice S4a.

maxAgeComplete.description: The exclusive maximum age for every dose of the series. Series-level, not per plan. Added in engine slice S4a.

StartAge.description: A start-age bracket: the half-open range [min, max) of the age at dose 1; max absent is open-ended. Added in engine slice S3b. ruleset.Validate checks that max is certainly after min and the EQ26 rules of a product group (no overlap, no missing bracket).

minIntervalFromFirst.description: Minimum time since dose 1 (SAD §5.2); added in engine slice S2.

RecalledDate.description: A date as the user remembers it (GLOSSARY: Recalled date).

value.description: YYYY-MM-DD for precision day, YYYY-MM for month, YYYY for year; absent for unknown (a dose record) and none (the birth date). Any string is accepted (I-JSON, see the root description); engine.Validate reports one that does not parse as INVALID_DATE, and a value with unknown or none as UNEXPECTED_VALUE (⚪ on a dose record, input error on the birth date).

product.description: A product ID of the rule set's catalog, retired ones included; added in engine slice S3a. Any non-empty string is accepted (no Id pattern): engine.Validate reports an ID the rule set does not have as UNKNOWN_PRODUCT, and Evaluate makes the record's diseases unknown, so that result stays reachable for a client that validates against the schema. Not with freeProduct (MUTUALLY_EXCLUSIVE).

freeProduct.description: The free-text name of an off-catalog product (F04.1); added in engine slice S3a. The engine reads only whether it is present.

doseNumbers.description: Disease ID → the dose number the user entered for that disease (F04.1); added in engine slice S2. engine.Validate reports a key that is not one of the record's diseases as UNKNOWN_REFERENCE.

DoseNumber.description: A user-entered dose number. Any JSON number with an integral value (1, 1.0, 1e0) is an integer here and decodes in Go.

seriesUsed.description: The candidate series after step 3 (SAD §5.3), in rule-set order, complete ones included; omitted when step 3 did not run and for an outOfAge block with no dose given. With no dose given and different candidates at the two birth ends, the later end's list (omitted when the later end has no candidate left). Added in engine slice S3a, extended in S3b and S4b.

products.description: The non-retired catalog products for the next dose, in snapshot order; present only with nextDose and when not empty. Added in engine slice S3a.

estimated.description: Present, and true, only when the result rests on an imprecise or missing date, a level-4 dose or an implied dose, or when PRODUCT_NOT_IN_CATALOG is given (EQ14); added in engine slice S2, extended in S3a.

ReasonParams.description: Every reason parameter; each code uses the members SAD §5.4 lists for it. Typed: IDs and enums are strings, counts are integers, lists are arrays; no booleans. Members are added additively.

candidates.description: Candidate series in rule-set order (SAFEST_SERIES, AGE_AT_START_UNCERTAIN); added in engine slice S3a.

doses.description: Dose record IDs: in time order, at least two, for OVERLAPPING_ESTIMATED_DATES; by ID, at least one, for PRODUCT_NOT_IN_CATALOG.

lastDay.description: The last allowed day of the next dose: L_k for DUE_CAPPED_BY_MAX_AGE, Lim for SERIES_MAY_NOT_COMPLETE; added in engine slice S4b.

SeriesRef.description: A candidate series and its product; product is omitted for a generic series. Added in engine slice S3a.
